source: test fixture — a partner keyed on one substance and renamed after a different order
description: DrugSafetyValidator.orderPartners keys a partner on the substance a covered code resolves, then OrderPartner.nameByOrder renames it after an order carrying a code the dataset cannot name (issue #186). Where that order is a DIFFERENT prescription from the one the partner was keyed on, the label names a drug the folded rule is not about — so the fold must not hand that label to the rule sentence. Ibuprofen's only rule is about naproxen; the second order's display says esomeprazole while its codes carry naproxen's, which is the mis-mapped-concept shape soleSubstanceOf merges on.

interactions.note: Moderate. Duplicate NSAID therapy: additive gastrointestinal toxicity.
